_readme: Random generation pools for generic characters, plus a few lists of flavor.
races: label, age range [min,max], look (image wording; null = built from the beastkin sub-type), mods (stat changes), subs (beastkin types), rare.
names: first (f) and last (l) names per race. builds/hairStyles/hairColors/eyes/skins/demonSkins/features: appearance picks for image prompts.
hooks: why she came to Hollowmere (used in AI backstories). gifts: what Sam gives when he buys a gift. clients: how anonymous clients are described in reports, per client class.
